 Veteran Rock Drummer Dies After Years-Long Cancer Battle as Family Shares Heartbreaking Tribute
 Drummer Bobby Taylor, a legend in the St. Louis rock music scene, has passed away after being diagnosed in 2021 with squamous cell carcinoma.
 By Stephen Andrew Galiher 
 November 9, 2026, 10:59am 
 Share: 
 Share on X (Opens in new window) X 
 Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook 
 Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard 
 Add Us On Google
 Veteran drummer Bobby Taylor, a staple of the St. Louis rock scene, has died. His passing comes after a years-long cancer battle. His family announced Taylor’s death in a heartbreaking tribute.
 “Love is knowing when to let go,” Taylor’s wife, Jami, wrote in a Facebook post. “Rest in peace, my beautiful sweet husband. You don’t have to fight or suffer anymore. Fly high, my love. We WILL be together again one day. Bobby Taylor lost his fight today. He fought until the bitter end. He was NOT going without a fight! Even the hospice nurses couldn’t believe what they were witnessing with his tenacity and to fight and hold on!”
 Videos by VICE 
 St. Louis drum legend Bobby Taylor has passed away
 Local music group Jamming.LIVE STL also shared an online memorial to Taylor. “Bobby Taylor wasn’t just a drummer,” they wrote in a Facebook post. “He was an absolute BEAST behind the drums!” the post read. “His energy, passion, and talent could light up any stage, and his powerful presence left a lasting impression on everyone who had the privilege of watching him perform. But beyond the music, Bobby was a genuinely kind soul with a big heart. He loved his wife deeply, and that love was just as powerful as the music he played.”
 “Bobby fought a heroic and courageous battle with cancer, showing incredible strength and determination along the way,” the post added. “Though his battle has come to an end, his legacy will live on through the music, the memories, and the countless lives he touched. We extend our deepest condolences to his beloved wife, family, friends, and fellow musicians. The stages may be a little quieter without Bobby, but the beat he left in our hearts will never fade.”
 View this post on Instagram 
 Finally, Taylor’s bandmates in the band Foreplay issued a statement on his passing. “The original Foreplay is mourning as a band,” they wrote. “We have lost a bandmate, a brother, a friend and an enormously talented drummer. He is loved and will be missed more than words can express.”
 “When Bobby Taylor joined Foreplay, it was like finding the missing piece of a puzzle. He made us complete. It was at that moment that the magic began. He loved playing drums with Foreplay. This is how we will remember Bobby,” the statement concluded. “May his memory always be a blessing!”
